build_biencoder_ranker: build a BiEncoderRanker from params dict to encode context mentions and candidate entities for entity linking
encode_context_mentions: encode context text into mention embeddings using the BiEncoderRanker encode_context method with top-k mention scoring
encode_candidate_entities: encode candidate entity texts into embeddings using the BiEncoderRanker encode_candidate method for retrieval
score_candidates: score candidate entities against context mentions using inner-product similarity via the score_candidate method
train_biencoder: train the BiEncoderRanker with in-batch or hard negatives using the forward method and cross-entropy or BCE loss
